high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a social media post by Aashish Kumar Dimri, who studies wealth. The post was made on August 9 and has received 485 upvotes and 6 comments. The post features a question: "Who are some rich people, who are just living on the money from one big thing that they did in life?" Below the question, there is a photograph of a man wearing glasses and a suit, along with an advertisement for Nirma detergent soap. The text accompanying the image provides information about Karsan Bhai Patel, a chemist who created detergent soap named after his daughter N
